name: light_presence
kind: light texture (PointLight2D), Viv's faint presence circle (player.tscn LocalLight), so she's never fully blind
centre_note: px-edge coordinates from the top-left = the texture centre (PointLight2D centres its texture on the node) = Viv's pivot; the bands are centred on it within ~1 px
scale_note: review at the whole-number art scale 4 (radius 256 art px = 3.2 u) = texture_scale 1.6 in world px (1 u = 32 world px = 80 art px). The old LocalLight was the 256 px lamp_pool.tres gradient at texture_scale 1.25 (radius 5 u, most of its light inside ~2.5 u). The brief allows whole-number scales only for light textures.
filter: nearest (project default_texture_filter 0), so the bands stay hard
energy_note: the brightest band is #bab4aa (0.71); the old gradient peaked at white, so at energy 0.6 the core is dimmer than before (energy ~0.85 gives the old peak). The review keeps 0.6: the presence should stay faint (for Beti / the Godot session).
design: option C 'long tail' (critic pick): a core ~21 px across that shows a few px past her sprite, three inner bands whose widths swell and pinch (4-13 px) so they don't run parallel, and a wide dim #272323 spill (~21-30 px) with 2-3 broad lobes; no band edge runs straight for more than 8 px
